description.zh:
播流域名。

多个域名之间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en:
The streaming domain name.

To specify multiple domain names, separate them with commas (,).

description.zh: 结束时间。需晚于起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh:
运营商英文名。

通过[DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~)接口获得。
description.en:
The name of the carrier.

You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~) operation to obtain the carrier name.

description.zh:
区域英文名。

通过[DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~)接口获得。
description.en:
The name of the region.

You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~) operation to obtain the region name.

description.zh: 起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 > 不写默认读取过去1小时数据。
description.en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

> If you do not specify this parameter, data in the last hour is queried.

title.zh: 获取加速域名的1分钟流量监控数据

descriptions.zh:
- 调用本接口查询播流域名下某个区域、运营商、时间段内的实时带宽流量。
- 不指定StartTime和EndTime时，默认读取过去1小时的数据，同时支持按指定的起止时间查询，两者需要同时指定。
- 本接口为监控数据接口，数据采集处理方式不同于计费，不能用于计算用量进行对账参考。
- 最多可获取最近90天的数据。

## QPS限制
本接口无单用户QPS限制，请您根据实际需要合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- Call this operation to query the real-time traffic and bandwidth of a streaming domain name for a specific region, carrier, and time period.

- If you do not specify the StartTime and EndTime parameters, data from the last hour is queried by default. To query data for a specific time range, you must specify both the StartTime and EndTime parameters.

- This operation returns monitoring data. This data is collected and processed differently from the data used for billing. Therefore, you cannot use the returned data for billing reconciliation.

- You can query data from the last 90 days.

## QPS limits

This operation has no queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user. You can call this operation as needed.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-domain-real-time-traffic-data --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com,example.aliyundoc.com --start-time 2015-12-10T15:00:00Z --isp-name-en alibaba --location-name-en tianjin --end-time 2015-12-10T15:01:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeLiveDomainRealTimeTrafficData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn alibaba --EndTime '2015-12-10T15:01:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com,example.aliyundoc.com' --LocationNameEn tianjin --StartTime '2015-12-10T15:00:00Z' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
